reference.analysis: Static Hopper analysis through reverse-engineer-anything; the Windows binary was not executed.

observations.question: Settings representation and admitted timer IDs
facts: S transfers four arguments to words at base + ID*8 + 0/2/4/6.
Reads clear the upper bits before loading each word; writes retain the low word.
D/E clear/set the selected color bit.

observations.question: Due calculation and traversal order
facts: Loop indices 0..99 address source IDs 1..100 in ascending order.
Mask, first day, last day and period are loaded with zero extension on every iteration.
Mask bit must match the current player.
First and last day bounds are inclusive.
The signed remainder of (day-firstDay)/zeroExtendedPeriod must be zero.
All skip branches and the success path share the single increment at 0x74a0eb; pseudocode displays misleading duplicate increments.
Later timer settings are read after earlier trigger bodies finish.

observations.question: Placement relative to ordinary map events
facts: Both wrappers call the timer dispatcher before the original function at 0x4cd5d0.
That original function checks event date, player flags and occurrence intervals.
Its apply routine at 0x4cd3d0 changes the seven player resources and presents the event text.
Identifying that pair as ordinary map-event scheduling/application is an inference from the combined operations.

documentedException.setting: A due timer with zero interval
documentedException.originalObservation: The original executes idiv without checking zero after date/mask checks; this would fault on a zero divisor.
documentedException.portBehavior: Explicit runtime error instead of an uncontrolled CPU division fault. Disabled or out-of-range timers do not divide.
documentedException.sourceCohort: All 51 S instructions in the eleven bundled campaign programs specify a positive literal interval.

limits: Static analysis establishes instructions and call order; it does not observe Windows execution.
Hopper does not report complete function body ranges; exact relevant instruction addresses are retained.
This contract does not validate the complete original quests or campaign wins.
